sources.title: MODA Cyber Security Management Act, revised 2025 official English text

limitations: Curated partial clause coverage only. The baseline is an assessment target, never a national security grade or a certification decision.

Revised Act expanded from 23 to 35 articles. Enforcement date and subordinate regulations must be confirmed against Executive Yuan orders. A–E responsibility levels are not mapped in this act-only pack.
